{{Top|leg}}
The '''quadranium edge''' was an enhanced melee weapon [[Edge (weapon)|edge]] that had been augmented by the addition of the element [[Quadranium/Legends|quadranium]]. The keenness and strength of this edge allowed for more deeply penetrating injuries, thus increasing the chance to incapacitate the enemy quickly.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
